name: Liltio
summary: Mac dictation app that runs speech recognition locally: hold the Fn or Globe key, speak, and the text lands in the field you are typing in, with optional AI to shorten, polish or translate. One-time licence for Apple silicon Macs.
best_for: Mac users on Apple silicon who dictate emails, notes and first drafts every day and want speech recognition on their own machine, paid for once instead of monthly
skip_if: you work on Windows or an Intel Mac, or you need dictation on more than two Macs per licence
honest_knock: It runs only on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15.5 or later, so Windows users and owners of Intel Macs are out, and one licence covers 2 Macs. Speech recognition is local, but if you switch on a configured remote AI for text transforms, your prompts, text and relevant context go to that provider. We found no refund terms on the pricing page.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Liltio Local · one-off, lifetime Local licence for 2 Macs at the standard price, before tax
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on liltio.com/#pricing; US dollars, before applicable taxes) Liltio sells one product, Liltio Local, as a one-time lifetime licence: $49 standard price, with no recurring subscription. A founding offer takes it to $29 for the first 100 paid licences, applied automatically while available; on 23 October 2026 the page counted 100 of 100 left and said availability is final at checkout. The licence covers 2 Macs and future Liltio updates; separately branded products are not included. Before buying there is a 14-day full local trial in the app, with no card and no automatic charge when it ends. It is a trial, not a free plan. The page showed the same amounts on 12 October 2026.

schema_offer.description: Liltio Local, lifetime Local licence for 2 Macs at the standard price, before tax; a $29 founding offer applies automatically to the first 100 paid licences while available (100 of 100 left on 23 October 2026). Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-23.

compare_with.name: Apple Dictation
compare_with.why: the dictation built into macOS costs nothing extra, so Liltio has to earn its price with what it adds: a hold-to-talk hotkey that inserts at your cursor, a personal dictionary and snippets, local history and optional AI transforms to shorten, polish or translate
